Container.Name: youtube-dl-server
Container.Overview:
Web / REST interface for downloading youtube videos onto a server.[br]
Enter a video url to download the video to the server. Url can be to YouTube or any other supported site. The server will automatically download the highest quality version available.
Just navigate to http://{{address}}:{{port}}/youtube-dl and enter the requested {{url}}.
curl -X POST --data-urlencode "url={{url}}" http://{{address}}:{{port}}/youtube-dl/q[br][br] [b]/youtube-dl[/b] : Downloads go there [br]

Config.Name: Proxy URL
Config.Description: Optional existing HTTP proxy for yt-dlp outbound requests and downloads. Example: http://UNRAID-IP:8118 (replace UNRAID-IP with your server IP). Binhex VPN containers can provide Privoxy on port 8118 when enabled; publish that port and allow this container to access the proxy. This setting does not create or manage a VPN. Leave blank to preserve existing behavior. Keep the normal bridge network and WebUI port mapping; sharing the VPN container network namespace is unnecessary. Requires an image version supporting YDL_PROXY.
